_about: The score's cues for tools/music/music.mjs (features/a_fully_voiced_game.md, section 8). One take per cue, never more: Eleven Music bills ~900 credits per generated minute and reports no cost, so tools/music/ledger.json records every request and nothing is made past maxSeconds. A cue has either a prompt (with force_instrumental) or a composition plan (chunks; vocals kept out by negative_styles and no lyric lines; seed only with a plan). conditioning: the first chunk is conditioned on a range of another cue's take (by cue name). A loop cue's last chunk returns to the opening; its loop is baked when it is processed (bpm is the hint for finding the beat).

klart.about: Stinger när ett ärende eller uppdrag är klart (från spiken).
klart.prompt: A short 5-second warm resolving cadence on felt piano and soft strings, A minor resolving to C major, Nordic winter melancholy, gentle, ends cleanly with a soft piano chord ringing out. Instrumental.
klart.note: Made in the spike (song twVU2s6goWY23YkowEIf); its request did not record force_instrumental.

tema.prompt: Instrumental only. The main theme of a quiet Swedish winter story about a grumpy, grieving old man who slowly thaws. A tender, melancholy Nordic melody in A minor on a solo felt piano, close-miked and intimate, slow and slightly rubato, around 66 BPM. It begins with the piano alone, lots of air between the phrases. After about 20 seconds soft muted strings enter beneath it and a cello answers the melody; the music warms and rises gently, restrained, never epic. In the last 15 seconds it thins back to the piano alone and ends cleanly on a soft A minor chord that rings out. Contemporary classical chamber music, warm room sound, great production quality. No vocals, no choir, no drums, no synthesizers.

plan.text:
